MASSIVE localizes the English text of SLURP:
  SLURP: A Spoken Language Understanding Resource Package, by
  Emanuele Bastianelli, Andrea Vanzo, Pawel Swietojanski and Verena Rieser.
  Source: https://github.com/pswietojanski/slurp/tree/8eb16545762be97ace75334109d73824217311f1
  SLURP's text is licensed under CC BY 4.0,
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
  (SLURP's audio is under CC BY-NC 4.0 and is not used.)

Changes: Syntropy's parity corpus (parity-corpus-v1 and later) uses the
utterance text of selected locales. Consecutive utterances of one locale are
joined with newlines into one item, and each item is tokenized per model
tokenizer. The utterance text is otherwise unchanged.

Paper: FitzGerald et al., "MASSIVE: A 1M-Example Multilingual Natural Language
Understanding Dataset with 51 Typologically-Diverse Languages", 2022,
arXiv:2204.08582.
